title: Simple Portable Beacon
description: Adds a tool to easily mark locations and death points
body:
# | DESCRIPTION | Adds a new item allowing you to set up a temporary beacon anywhere by dropping the item on the ground. It will also trigger on death, making it easy to get back to your death location. The recipe below will not be shown in the in-game recipe book until crafted, so make sure you reference this page or have a mod to show the recipe. The beam will go through blocks above it, and will move with the item if moved in water or with a piston. Stack size is limited to 1. Also, it will despawn after 5 minutes of being loaded, so it's not a permanent beam (unless you use a dropper to replace it)
![Crafting recipe for a Portable Beacon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e37305099f137a78a85e6f8f15c9e8f4223df3af.png) # | VERSIONS | Currently supports Minecraft Java ```1.21.5-26.2```. # | COMPATIBILITY | Incompatible with packs that use the same recipe, tags, or function name. It uses the vanilla glowstone dust item, so you can craft it into the same things, but it's more valuable so don't forget and waste it. ## | Patreon | Join my new Patreon to support my projects!
